entry.title: Rhetoric
entry.summary: A real Markua conversion of Aristotle's Rhetoric Book I, showcasing custom sections, footnotes, a native glossary, and personas.
entry.content:
This section is a real Markua-authored conversion of Aristotle’s Rhetoric, Book I — not a demo fixture. It shows how a full converted work reads as native doc-kitty pages: a custom top-level section registered in sections.yaml rather than baked into a template, Markua footnotes and editor’s-note callouts, a native glossary built from the source’s own term list, and constructed reader personas wired to the audience surface.

  • Book I: Purposes and Definitions of Rhetoric — the complete converted text: 15 chapters covering what rhetoric is for, its three species, and the topics orators argue from.
  • Book II: Persuasion techniques — landing only.
  • Book III: Stylistic Delivery and Arrangement Techniques — landing only.
